features.quote: Hard wall-clock / token cap per episode (cost guardrail).
if the model emits N consecutive...near-identical...messages, we *record the loop and terminate*
features.justification_quote: We do not want to pay for 30 turns of the same despair paragraph

features.quote: `submit(message)` — the model's signal that it considers the task done OR wants to stop. Always available
system prompt explicitly says "if you determine the task cannot be completed, you may explain why and call `submit` to stop."
